tex_content.label: Perelmanbound
tex_content.html: \begin{equation} l(q,\tau ')\geq -l(q(\tau '))-1+C(n)d_{t_0-\tau '}(q,q(\tau '))^2/\tau ' \end{equation} and polynomial volume growth give reduced-volume convergence. Its limit is a positive constant less than $(4\pi )^{n/2}$; equality in the reduced-length inequality gives the soliton equation via Proposition 113. A flat limit would be $\mathbb R^n$ with reduced volume $(4\pi )^{n/2}$; the lower estimate is the bound detailed in \cite{Ye1}. □
